statement: On desk routes the left column becomes the Stack: Now (the armed block), Earlier today (blocks, resumable in place), Queues (Tasks, Work orders, Picker queue, To-ship as the existing tables), Find (the launch index). The sidebar page tree rendered by SidebarNavColumn is removed from the rail; every leaf stays in launch-index.ts so ⌘K and Find reach it. Pins and recents keep their positions. A pure stackModel is shared with the phone.
